query.rationale: SQL-like query defining the logical view over Bigtable data. It is metadata/configuration and does not directly grant access, enforce encryption, or expose sensitive data by itself.

logical_view_id.description: The unique name of the logical view in the form `[_a-zA-Z0-9][-_.a-zA-Z0-9]*`.
logical_view_id.rationale: Terraform identifier for the logical view. It is metadata/configuration and does not directly grant access, enforce encryption, or expose sensitive data by itself.

deletion_protection.description: Set to true to make the logical view protected against deletion.
deletion_protection.rationale: Protects against accidental deletion of the logical view. It is metadata/configuration and does not directly grant access, enforce encryption, or expose sensitive data by itself.

instance.description: The name of the instance to create the logical view within.
instance.rationale: Hosting Bigtable instance. It is metadata/configuration and does not directly grant access, enforce encryption, or expose sensitive data by itself.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: GCP project ID. It is metadata/configuration and does not directly grant access, enforce encryption, or expose sensitive data by itself.
